source.title: Drik Panchang — 2026 Dwadasha Siddhividya Jayanti
notes: Drik Panchang lists twelve Siddhividya Jayantis: Saraswati, Kubjika, Siddhilakshmi, Chandika, Batuka Bhairavi, Parvati, Dakshinamurti, Gayatri, Vindhyavasini, Aparajita, Bala and Annapurna.
Dates and lunar tithis are transcribed from the retrieved Drik Panchang 2026 listing for Koath, Bihar; they are not independently recalculated for Pithoragarh.

Some dates can vary by location/sunrise convention; the same Drik listing shows Annapurna Jayanti on 24 December 2026, while other location results can show 23 December. Verify for the site's chosen location and compare with the owner's Ganesh Martand Panchang before runtime use.
This Dwadasha Siddhividya list is distinct from the separate Dashamahavidya list and must not be merged into it.

validation: Dates are transcribed from the cited Drik Panchang 2026 listing, not independently recalculated.
